stages.stage: instruction issue (one instruction per cycle, fp16 add as compiled)
stages.basis: 96 B and 26.0 issued instructions per program (RTL counters); observed IPC 0.129

stages.stage: core port, LSU and tensor transfer engine (64-bit word per request)
stages.basis: one 8-byte request accepted per cycle by the core NI (768 in 768 cycles, w64-stages2-stall0.log); the LSU and the transfer engine share this port

stages.stage: LSU memory-level parallelism (commands in flight / round-trip latency)
stages.basis: LSU_INFLIGHT=2 commands of 32 B (image parameter) over a mean round trip of 73.0 cycles per word request (Little's law on RTL counters; mean 5.42 words outstanding per core)

stages.stage: NI and mesh NoC (one 216-bit flit with 64-bit data per cycle and virtual network)
NUCA home slice, streaming (2 reads : 1 write, as fp16 add)
stages.basis: reads 6.31 and writes 6.66 cycles per word with a 40-cycle synthetic DRAM (mode2-lat40-stall0, mode3-lat40-stall0)

stages.stage: AXI outlet (tnca_line_axi, default issue, 8 lines outstanding)
stages.basis: 2.24 cycles per line with a 16-cycle responder; 2.00 with 32 slots (issue limit)

stages.stage: HBM pseudo-channel behind one outlet (8-line window)
stages.basis: Ramulator2 HBM2 PC, 2.10216 GB/s read with 8 lines in flight, 6.18009 GB/s with 64 (issue-limited at one line per cycle)

stages.stage: end to end, fp16 add, 64 Mi elements (measured)
